title: aggregate router
description: Collects messages; when the group is complete (the last part of a split, completionSize messages, completionTimeout without a new message, or every completionInterval), releases a message with the aggregate of their bodies, made from the last, along the link, ignoring what comes of it. The message that came in carries on as it came. A body that is no XML or JSON fails. Without a timer the first part of a split drops what a failed split left. With correlationKey, the messages whose key has the same value make a group, and each group completes on its own. A group that is not complete when the flow stops is lost, unless store keeps the groups. In DIL it is an action.

aggregateType.title: Aggregate type
aggregateType.description: XML: the parts' root elements in <Aggregated>, after an XML declaration; JSON: an array of the parts

completionSize.title: Completion size
completionSize.description: Number of messages that complete a group; 0: only the last part of a split does

completionTimeout.title: Completion timeout
completionTimeout.description: Milliseconds without a new message that complete the group; 0: none

completionInterval.title: Completion interval
completionInterval.description: Milliseconds between the completions of the group; 0: none

correlationKey.title: Correlation key
correlationKey.description: Simple expression whose value groups the messages, such as ${header.orderId}; empty: one group

store.title: Store
store.description: Name of a store in dil.core.stores that keeps the groups, so that a durable store keeps them over a restart; empty: in memory
